items.prompt: Fit all the pieces into the outline. You have 1 large triangle, 1 small triangle, 1 square and 1 parallelogram.
hints: Start with the biggest outline. It needs the large triangle.
Match a long straight edge of a piece to an edge of the outline. Tap Turn if the piece points the wrong way.
The parallelogram can lean left or right. Tap Flip if it leans the wrong way.
items.explanation: The 4 pieces fit together with no gaps: 1 large triangle, 1 small triangle, 1 square and 1 parallelogram. Each piece fills one outline exactly.

items.prompt: Make a shape with exactly 5 sides.
hints: Count the sides in the Sides box. You need 5.

If your shape is not right, tap Undo to remove the last corner and try another peg.
items.explanation: One answer uses the pegs (0,0), (2,0), (3,1), (2,2), (0,2). It has 5 sides, a perimeter of 8.8 and an area of 5 square units.
